acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Rotwalkers family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Rot Brute, T3, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Open-Rib Plague Pump (Specialist) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two earth construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A muscle-corded, bloated corpse with bone burst through both forearms as natural blades, a ribcage cracked open around a visible plague sac, and reinforced legs built to brace the pumping action.

Signature mechanic: Ribcage Peristalsis: the bloated Brute plants both forearm bone blades and opens its cracked ribs like pump handles. One visible wet trail leading to a Shambler or Ghoul pulses from corpse to corpse, then erupts in a sequence of short grasping hands. Only one network can be charged; breaking any bright tendon junction stops the eruption and vents the Brute's belly.
battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot the floor into route control by pumping infected matter through existing corpse trails, turning familiar Shambler falls and Ghoul anchors into timed eruption lines.
constructionDimensions: Grave matter reinforces rather than replaces the corpse: packed loam braces joints, mineral salts crust exposed sinew, wet bone calcifies into load-bearing blades, and T4–T5 corpse seams lock around tombstone-like ossified plates.

Stance becomes fault-driven through rooted dragging feet, compressed grave-soil wakes local to contact, pale stress lines across loaded bone, and sediment shedding from only the body currently carrying composite weight.
counterplay: Leave the pulsing route, sever one exposed tendon junction between bodies, or strike the swollen sac through the open ribs before the third pulse; the planted blades prevent the Brute from turning during the cast. Affinity signal: A calcified tendon or shared suture turns chalk-white after the form commits its weight; breaking that fault releases the supported limb or corpse cluster.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only earth treatment without grave reinforcement, mineralized seams, and changed load paths
Glow-only earth treatment without a readable fracture or binding joint
Pasted rocks that hide human anatomy, wet openings, or death wounds
Solid stone replacement that makes the family read as golems rather than animated corpses
identityInvariants: A recognizably human but wrong silhouette retains dislocated shoulders, a dragging or mismatched gait, a hanging jaw, and a head or torso held at an impossible angle.
Grey-green and bruise-purple flesh, dried-blood brown, bile yellow, and dirty linen white remain bodily and funerary rather than elemental colors.
Rotting flesh, exposed sinew, wet bone, grave dirt, torn burial clothing, and the visible marks or embedded tools of death preserve each corpse's material history.
Every form is wet and partly open, with readable seams at tendons, ribs, sutures, or fused bodies that explain both animation and counterplay.
Escalation reverses decay into coordination: sagging fragments become corded muscle, reinforced bone, cooperative corpse anatomy, and finally a plague court built from many still-legible bodies.
telegraph: Forearm blades lock into the ground, the cracked ribcage spreads around a swollen central sac, and one chain of wet footprints and corpse seams begins pulsing toward the selected lane.
